0022600145.text: The New Orleans Pelicans (0-4, 14th in the West) host the Sacramento Kings (0-4, 15th in the West) in the fifth game of the Pelicans' season, and the Pelicans are on a four-game losing streak with an 0-2 home record. The teams have not met yet in 2026-27, and the Pelicans won the 2025-26 season series 2-1, though Sacramento took the most recent meeting 117-113 in Sacramento on April 3, 2026. New Orleans is missing Yves Missi (out, knee bruise) and Jordan Poole is day-to-day with an ankle injury and a game-time decision, while Sacramento is without Ben Simmons (out, Achilles surgery), Dylan Cardwell (out, calf strain), Keegan Murray (out, ankle), and Maxime Raynaud (out, dislocated knee).
